# paperclip_company (Data Source)

Reads Paperclip company details.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "paperclip_company" "acme" {
  name = "Acme"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Company unique identifier.
- `name` (String) Company name.

### Read-Only

- `default_responsible_user_id` (String) Default responsible user identifier.
- `description` (String) Company description.
- `feedback_data_sharing_enabled` (Boolean) Whether feedback data sharing is enabled for the company.
- `interaction_resolver_governance` (String) Interaction resolver governance policy configuration as a JSON object.
- `logo_asset_id` (String) Logo asset reference identifier.
- `require_board_approval_for_new_agents` (Boolean) Whether adding new agents requires board approval.
- `status` (String) Administrative status of the company (active, paused, or archived).
